item.title: Trojanized npm Packages Decode C2 IP From Ethereum Recipient Addresses
item.summary: Cybersecurity researchers have flagged an evolution of the EtherHiding blockchain-based command-and-control (C2) technique that conceals the C2 server IP address inside a made-up destination address of a completely empty Ethereum transfer. The new dead drop resolver approach, observed in two trojanized npm package "bianira-ui" and "fluid-type-ui," has been codenamed NullReceiver by
